description: Synthetic Japanese short-text datasets for classification/clustering education. All texts are hand-curated CC0 examples with no PII. See data/README.md for full provenance and known limitations.

generator.author: SPReAD-1000 quickstart maintainers
generator.note: Intended for education only. Do NOT use as ground truth for real disinformation detection, real sentiment inference, or real topic modeling. The disinformation set discriminates by *stylistic* features (conspiratorial vocabulary, unsupported claims) and does NOT verify factual truth of any statement.
